title: Ancient 'as above, so below' symbol on property

tellings.quote: As above, so below as the Masonic symbol on the property from ancient times seems to denote.

plain: There is a symbol on Skinwalker Ranch, a Utah property known for reports of strange events, that the ranch's owner says dates "from ancient times" and seems to stand for "as above, so below," which he calls a Masonic symbol, meaning one tied to the Freemasons, a centuries-old secret fraternity. The owner, who is not named in these tellings, speaks as someone who knows the land first-hand, and he raises it in an episode about a UFO said to lie under the ranch, as though the symbol hints that what happens in the sky mirrors something underground.
